title.zh: Riot三季度抛售79%比特币持仓，转向280亿美元AI数据中心租赁
title.en: Riot sells 79% of its bitcoin holdings in Q3, pivoting to a $28 billion AI data center lease

summary.zh: 矿企Riot Platforms三季度出售10,599枚比特币 (Bitcoin, BTC)，持仓从11,380枚降至2,418枚，降幅约79%；前三季度累计出售20,264枚、套现约15亿美元，所得主要用于数据中心建设。同期公司签署为期15年、覆盖德州科西卡纳 (Corsicana) 910兆瓦算力容量的租赁协议，初始合同价值约280亿美元，租户为一家前沿人工智能实验室 (Frontier AI Lab)。这一转向显示部分矿企正把能源与场地资产从挖矿转向人工智能 (Artificial Intelligence, AI) 基础设施，但该项目约55亿美元的资本开支仍主要依赖以租赁款为支撑的融资，而融资尚未完全落实。
summary.en: Miner Riot Platforms sold 10,599 bitcoin in the third quarter, cutting its holdings from 11,380 BTC to 2,418 BTC, a drop of about 79%; across the first nine months it sold 20,264 BTC for roughly $1.5 billion, with the proceeds mainly funding data center construction. At the same time, the company signed a 15-year lease covering 910 megawatts of capacity at its Corsicana, Texas campus, valued at about $28 billion initially, with a frontier AI lab as tenant. The shift shows some miners redirecting energy and site assets from mining toward AI infrastructure, though the project still needs about $5.5 billion of capital spending backed by financing that has not yet been fully secured.

title.zh: 比特币从六周低点反弹，现货ETF单日净流出放缓至1.156亿美元
title.en: Bitcoin rebounds from six-week low as spot ETF outflows slow to $115.6 million on Nov 3

summary.zh: 比特币 (Bitcoin, BTC) 在跌破76,000美元、触及约75,736美元的六周低点后回升至78,000美元附近，收复了中期选举计票期间的大部分跌幅。美国现货ETF (Spot ETF) 11月3日净流出1.156亿美元，较11月2日的3.986亿美元大幅收窄，但三日累计流出仍约11.6亿美元，显示机构需求尚未全面恢复。Bitfinex指出此次反弹更多由杠杆驱动而非现货买盘支撑，并把75,839美元的短期持有者成本位视为关键支撑，跌破该水平将削弱反弹结构。
summary.en: Bitcoin recovered to around $78,000 after dipping below $76,000 to a six-week low near $75,736, erasing most of the losses seen during the midterm vote count. U.S. spot ETFs recorded $115.6 million of net outflows on November 3, sharply narrower than the $398.6 million on November 2, though the three-session total still reached about $1.16 billion, showing institutional demand has not fully returned. Bitfinex said the rebound looks more leverage-driven than spot-led and flagged the $75,839 short-term holder cost basis as key support, below which the recovery structure would weaken.

title.zh: 中期选举后加密市场反弹，DeFi板块领涨
title.en: Crypto market rebounds after midterm dip, led by DeFi tokens

summary.zh: 加密市场在中期选举计票引发的抛售后回升，比特币 (Bitcoin, BTC) 回到约78,300美元，以太坊 (Ethereum, ETH) 升至约2,313美元，CoinDesk的DeFi精选指数 (DeFi Select Index) 上涨约5%，表现强于大盘。市场最初因民主党赢得国会控制权而下跌，随后随美股期货转正而修复，恐惧与贪婪指数 (Fear & Greed Index) 也从26回升至34至37区间。交易员目前关注周五公布的美国10月非农就业报告，该数据可能决定反弹能否延续。
summary.en: Crypto markets recovered after the midterm-count selloff, with bitcoin back near $78,300, ether near $2,313, and CoinDesk's DeFi Select Index up about 5%, outperforming the broader market. Prices first fell as Democrats won control of Congress, then recovered as U.S. stock futures turned positive, while the fear and greed index improved from 26 into the 34-37 range. Traders are now watching Friday's U.S. October payrolls report, which could determine whether the rebound holds.

title.zh: BTCPay Server旧版本热钱包遭横扫，约162万美元被盗
title.en: BTCPay Server hot wallets drained on older versions, about $1.62 million stolen

summary.zh: 开源比特币支付处理商BTCPay Server警告称，运行2.4.1及更早版本的服务器热钱包 (Hot Wallet) 遭到未经授权的横扫，攻击者利用了与2.4.2已修复漏洞不同的手法。据Bitquery统计，被盗金额约162万美元（18.38枚比特币与3,405枚莱特币），涉及682次转移，其中87%的资金集中在11月1日的一波转移中。BTCPay Server表示最新2.4.7版本暂无可信被盗报告，并建议旧版本用户升级至2.4.7、迁移至新钱包并轮换全部密钥与凭证。
summary.en: Open-source bitcoin payment processor BTCPay Server warned that hot wallets on servers running version 2.4.1 or earlier were swept by unauthorized attackers, using a different method from the vulnerability fixed in version 2.4.2. Bitquery counted about $1.62 million stolen (18.38 BTC and 3,405 LTC) across 682 sweeps, with 87% of the funds moved in a single wave on November 1. BTCPay Server said it has no credible reports of drains on the latest 2.4.7 release and advised users on older versions to upgrade, move funds to a fresh wallet, and rotate all keys and credentials.

title.zh: 民主党赢得国会控制权，加密立法前景增添不确定性
title.en: Democrats win control of Congress, clouding crypto legislation outlook

summary.zh: 民主党在美国中期选举中赢得参众两院控制权，投资者担心亲加密立法与放松监管议程将被推迟，甚至面临更严格的监管审查，比特币与以太坊在选举结果出炉之初双双下跌。随后市场随美股反弹而修复，比特币回到约78,000美元、以太坊回到约2,300美元，但监管前景的不确定性仍未消除。市场接下来将关注新一届国会如何处理市场结构法案 (CLARITY Act) 等悬而未决的加密立法，以及监管机构的人事与执法方向。
summary.en: Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, raising investor concern that pro-crypto legislation and deregulation could be delayed or face stricter regulatory scrutiny, with bitcoin and ether initially falling as results came in. Markets later recovered alongside U.S. equities, with bitcoin back near $78,000 and ether near $2,300, but the regulatory uncertainty remains. Attention now turns to how the new Congress handles pending crypto bills such as the CLARITY Act market-structure legislation, as well as regulators' staffing and enforcement direction.

title.zh: 以太坊研究员提出2028年12月完成抗量子升级目标，较路线图提前一年
title.en: Ethereum researcher targets December 2028 for post-quantum transition, a year early

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会 (Ethereum Foundation) 研究员Justin Drake在孟买Devcon 8上表示，希望以太坊在2028年12月完成抗量子 (Post-Quantum) 与后人工智能 (Post-AI) 过渡，较基金会2025年9月路线图的2029年12月目标提前一年。他同时强调这只是一个愿景而非正式期限，并不取代现有路线图，基金会预计2027年1月重新评估该路线图。要实现该目标，开发者需要在约24个月内交付三次网络升级，候选哈希签名方案包括leanSPHINCS与leanXMSS。
summary.en: Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake said at Devcon 8 in Mumbai that he hopes Ethereum can complete its post-quantum and post-AI transition by December 2028, one year ahead of the foundation's September 2025 roadmap target of December 2029. He stressed the date is an aspiration rather than a confirmed deadline and does not replace the existing roadmap, which the foundation expects to reassess in January 2027. Meeting the goal would require developers to deliver three network upgrades within about 24 months, with hash-based signature candidates leanSPHINCS and leanXMSS under research.

title.zh: SEC工作人员认定Canton Coin为数字商品并给予有限不采取行动救济
title.en: SEC staff view Canton Coin as a digital commodity, granting limited no-action relief

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 公司金融部在11月3日的复函中表示，基于项目方陈述，Canton Coin (CC) 被视为数字商品 (Digital Commodity)，对其按所述方式由超级验证者、验证者与应用提供者程序化铸造的行为，工作人员不建议采取执法行动。该救济回应了Digital Asset Holdings于10月30日提交的问询，理由是该代币价值源于Canton网络的程序化运行与供需关系，且网络不存在“中心方”。工作人员同时强调，这只是执法立场而非委员会裁决，不表达法律结论，也不对该代币作出背书，事实变化可能导致结论改变。
summary.en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's Division of Corporation Finance said in a November 3 response that, based on the project's representations, Canton Coin (CC) is viewed as a digital commodity, and staff will not recommend enforcement action over its programmatic minting by Super Validators, Validators and application providers as described. The relief answers an October 30 request from Digital Asset Holdings, resting on the token deriving value from the Canton Network's programmatic operation and supply and demand, with no 'central party' controlling the network. Staff stressed this is only an enforcement position, not a Commission decision, expressing no legal conclusion and no endorsement of the token, and different facts could change the outcome.

title.zh: 币安披露63.4亿美元盗窃案始于6月供应链入侵与虚假招聘
title.en: Binance says $6.34 billion theft began with June supply-chain intrusion and fake job interviews

summary.zh: 币安在11月3日的初步事件报告中披露，约63.4亿美元盗窃案是一场始于6月的多阶段攻击：钱包基础设施团队一名工程师下载了被篡改的人工智能 (Artificial Intelligence, AI) 编程工具安装包，9月另一名工程师在虚假招聘的编程“作业”中下载恶意软件，攻击者于10月20日取得另一名工程师机器上的容器部署权限，并于10月29日发动攻击。币安称约28.5亿美元已被冻结或拦截，已补足98%的受影响代币资产，剩余部分正在购回；同时称今年已拦截57起疑似朝鲜相关威胁，并将委托独立安全公司复核事件。
summary.en: Binance said in its initial incident report on November 3 that the roughly $6.34 billion theft was a multi-stage campaign beginning in June: a wallet-infrastructure engineer downloaded a tampered installer for a popular AI coding tool, a second engineer downloaded malware in a coding 'assignment' during a fake job interview in September, attackers found a container deployment permission on another wallet engineer's machine on October 20, and launched the attack on October 29. Binance said about $2.85 billion has been frozen or intercepted, 98% of affected token assets have been replenished with the rest being repurchased, and its team blocked 57 other suspected North Korea-linked threats this year, with independent security firms engaged to review the incident.

title.zh: Solana三季度应用收入近3亿美元环比增50%，稳定币市值创175.1亿美元新高
title.en: Solana Q3 app revenue nears $300 million, up 50%, as stablecoin cap hits record $17.51 billion

summary.zh: Solana官方三季度更新显示，生态应用收入接近3亿美元，较二季度增长约50%，现货去中心化交易所 (Decentralized Exchange, DEX) 交易量达到1,970亿美元，稳定币 (Stablecoin) 市值升至175.1亿美元，创历史新高。开发者参与度同样强劲，Colosseum的Frontier活动收到近2,900个项目投稿，显示建设者兴趣持续。尽管链上指标走强，分析人士提醒，生态增长并不总能同步转化为SOL价格短期上涨，价格走势仍取决于市场情绪与资金面。
summary.en: Solana's official third-quarter update showed ecosystem application revenue of nearly $300 million, up about 50% from the second quarter, spot decentralized exchange (DEX) trading volume of $197 billion, and a stablecoin market capitalization of $17.51 billion, a new all-time high. Developer participation also stayed strong, with nearly 2,900 project submissions to Colosseum's Frontier initiative. Analysts cautioned that stronger on-chain metrics do not always translate into short-term gains for SOL, with price action still driven by market sentiment and liquidity.

title.zh: Solana现实世界资产规模首破50亿美元，30天转账量达162亿美元
title.en: Solana's real-world asset value tops $5 billion for the first time

summary.zh: RWA.xyz数据显示，Solana链上已分配现实世界资产 (Real-World Assets, RWA) 价值于10月29日达到约51.9亿美元，创历史新高，11月2日至3日回落至约51.2亿美元，仍较30天前增长约17.6%。30天转账量达162亿美元，代币化资产数量为3516个，持有者约86万，增长主要来自代币化股票、国债和私人信贷。这一里程碑显示传统资产上链正在加速，但单日峰值回落也提醒该规模仍会随市场波动。
summary.en: Data from RWA.xyz showed Solana's distributed real-world asset value reaching about $5.19 billion on October 29, a record high, before easing to about $5.12 billion by November 2-3, still up about 17.6% over 30 days. Thirty-day transfer volume reached $16.2 billion across 3,516 tokenized assets held by roughly 860,000 holders, driven by tokenized equities, Treasuries and private credit. The milestone points to accelerating on-chain adoption of traditional assets, though the pullback from the peak shows the total still moves with market conditions.

title.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF单日净流出1.398亿美元，连续第六天遭赎回
title.en: US spot ether ETFs lose $139.8 million in a sixth straight day of outflows

summary.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 11月2日净流出1.398亿美元，为连续第六个交易日净流出，其中贝莱德ETHA占1.383亿美元，基金总资产降至约131.8亿美元。彭博分析师James Seyffart估计，以太币ETF持有人的平均成本接近3200美元，10月底账面浮亏已近35亿美元。尽管资金持续流出，以太币价格11月3日仍小幅反弹至约2290美元，显示现货需求与基金赎回之间出现分化。
summary.en: US spot ether ETFs recorded $139.8 million in net outflows on November 2, a sixth consecutive day of redemptions, with BlackRock's ETHA accounting for $138.3 million and total fund assets falling to about $13.18 billion. Bloomberg analyst James Seyffart estimated ether ETF holders' average cost at just under $3,200, leaving them with almost $3.5 billion in unrealized losses at the end of October. Despite the outflows, ether rebounded modestly to about $2,290 on November 3, a sign that spot demand and fund redemptions are diverging.

title.zh: Bullish将以太坊、Solana和Aptos列为代币化股票首批网络
title.en: Bullish names Ethereum, Solana and Aptos as first networks for tokenized shares

summary.zh: 纽交所上市公司Bullish 11月3日宣布，将以太坊、Solana和Aptos作为发行人赞助型代币化股票 (Issuer-Sponsored Tokenized Shares) 服务的首批网络，发行公司可自主选择上链网络，官方股东名册仍由过户代理 (Transfer Agent) Equiniti维护。此前Bullish已在Solana上完成全部股权上链，并在10月27日于纽交所演示了6100万股代币化股份的秒级转移。公司对Equiniti的42亿美元收购预计2027年1月完成，但Aptos和以太坊的上线时间尚未公布。
summary.en: NYSE-listed Bullish announced on November 3 that Ethereum, Solana and Aptos will be the first networks for its issuer-sponsored tokenized share services, letting issuers choose where their shares live while transfer agent Equiniti keeps the official ownership record. Bullish has already tokenized its full equity cap table on Solana and demonstrated a transfer of 61 million tokenized shares in seconds at the New York Stock Exchange on October 27. Its $4.2 billion acquisition of Equiniti is expected to close in January 2027, but no launch dates for Aptos or Ethereum were given.

title.zh: Aztec上线Tierra V6升级，修复关键证明漏洞并提速隐私交易
title.en: Aztec launches Tierra V6 upgrade, fixing a critical proving bug and speeding up private transactions

summary.zh: 以太坊隐私二层网络 (Layer 2) Aztec 11月3日上线Tierra升级 (Alpha V6)，修复了V5版本中一个关键的零知识证明 (Zero-Knowledge Proof) 系统漏洞，并引入形式化验证 (Formal Verification) 与AI驱动的安全测试工具。升级后客户端隐私交易证明生成时间约1秒，较此前快一倍，以太坊至Aztec的消息传递时间从平均2分钟缩短至最快12秒。升级同时伴随品牌更新与一批隐私应用上线，包括重启的私人支付应用zk.money。
summary.en: Ethereum privacy layer-2 network Aztec launched its Tierra upgrade, Alpha V6, on November 3, fixing a critical vulnerability in the V5 zero-knowledge proving system and adding formal verification plus an AI-powered security testing harness. Client-side private transaction proofs now take about one second, roughly twice as fast as before, while Ethereum-to-Aztec message delivery fell from an average of two minutes to as little as 12 seconds. The upgrade arrives with a rebrand and new privacy apps, including the relaunched private payments app zk.money.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF周一净流出3.99亿美元，两日合计超10.4亿美元
title.en: US spot bitcoin ETFs lose $399 million on Monday, taking two-day outflows past $1.04 billion

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 11月2日净流出3.99亿美元，为连续第二天净流出，两日合计超过10.4亿美元，其中贝莱德IBIT单日流出4.053亿美元，为6月以来最大单日流出。受此影响，2026年以来累计净流入基本被抹平，机构风险偏好明显转弱。与此同时，比特币价格在11月3日欧洲时段跌至约76300美元后回稳至约76900美元附近。
summary.en: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $399 million on November 2, a second straight day of outflows that took the two-day total past $1.04 billion, with BlackRock's IBIT shedding $405 million in its largest daily outflow since June. The selling effectively wiped out the funds' net inflows for 2026, signalling weaker institutional risk appetite. Bitcoin dipped to about $76,300 in the European morning on November 3 before steadying near $76,900.

title.zh: 币安完成10种资产零知识储备证明，称已补回约95%被盗资产
title.en: Binance completes zero-knowledge proof of reserves for 10 assets, saying about 95% of stolen funds are replenished

summary.zh: 币安11月2日宣布，已完成基于10月31日快照的零知识储备证明 (Zero-Knowledge Proof of Reserves)，覆盖比特币、以太币、USDT、BNB、SOL、USDC、XRP等10种资产，用户可通过开源验证工具自行核查余额至少1:1备付。币安称，已用公司资金和SAFU基金补回约95%的被盗资产，剩余部分为流动性较差的代币，仍在继续买入。新的快照定于11月4日进行，证明生成约需40至50小时；储备证明是某一时点的快照，并非全面审计。
summary.en: Binance said on November 2 it had completed a zero-knowledge proof of reserves based on an October 31 snapshot, covering 10 assets including bitcoin, ether, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC and XRP, letting users verify with an open-source tool that balances are backed at least 1:1. The exchange said it had replenished about 95% of the stolen assets from company funds and its SAFU fund, with the remainder in less liquid tokens still being acquired. A new snapshot is set for November 4, with the proof taking about 40 to 50 hours to generate; a proof of reserves is a point-in-time snapshot, not a full audit.

title.zh: 美国SEC新增三条加密FAQ，厘清共享治理与去中心化认定
title.en: SEC staff add three crypto FAQs clarifying shared governance and decentralization

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 公司金融部11月2日在加密资产常见问题 (FAQ) 中新增第1.4至1.6条，阐明广泛共享治理的参与者通常不因共同投票而被视为一个控制集团，除非存在关联关系或协同行动的约定。新增内容还区分了“功能性系统”与“去中心化”：前者指代币可按设计用途使用，后者要求没有任何个人、实体或协调集团掌握运营、经济或投票控制权。需要留意的是，这只是工作人员指引，不具法律效力，也未取代国会正在推进的CLARITY法案立法工作。
summary.en: The US Securities and Exchange Commission's Division of Corporation Finance added questions 1.4 to 1.6 to its crypto asset FAQ on November 2, clarifying that participants in broad-based shared governance are generally not treated as a controlling group merely for voting together, absent affiliations or agreements to act in concert. The new answers also separate a 'functional system', where a token can be used as designed, from decentralization, which requires no person, entity or coordinated group holding operational, economic or voting control. The update is staff guidance with no legal force and does not replace Congress's pending CLARITY Act legislation.

title.zh: 巴西Mercado Bitcoin遭约4000万美元攻击后承诺全额承担用户损失
title.en: Mercado Bitcoin pledges to cover user losses after roughly $40 million hack

summary.zh: 巴西最大加密交易所Mercado Bitcoin 11月2日凌晨发现一起安全事件后暂停存取款，并于11月3日表示将承担约3800万至4000万美元的损失，客户不会受损，也没有客户数据泄露。安全公司Hypernative标记的可疑转账超过4000万美元，涉及至少10条区块链，交易所称已在Tether、Circle和Chainalysis协助下冻结约1100万美元。事件发生几天前币安刚遭遇约63亿美元盗窃，Mercado Bitcoin未将两者关联，恢复时间尚未公布。
summary.en: Brazil's largest crypto exchange, Mercado Bitcoin, suspended deposits and withdrawals after detecting a security incident early on November 2, and said on November 3 it will cover losses of roughly $38 million to $40 million so no customer loses funds, with no customer data leaked. Security firm Hypernative flagged more than $40 million in suspicious transfers across at least 10 blockchains, and the exchange said about $11 million had been frozen with help from Tether, Circle and Chainalysis. The incident came days after Binance's roughly $6.3 billion theft, which Mercado Bitcoin has not linked to its own breach, and no restart date has been given.

title.zh: 加密市场单日蒸发约1150亿美元，比特币跌至约76464美元
title.en: Crypto market sheds about $115 billion in a day as bitcoin falls to about $76,464

summary.zh: 加密市场总市值24小时内下跌约4.3%至2.56万亿美元，蒸发约1150亿美元，比特币下跌2.25%至约76464美元，以太币下跌2.01%至约2249美元，比特币市占率仍接近59.8%。抛售发生在美国现货比特币ETF周一净流出近3.99亿美元之后，叠加美国中期选举前的不确定性与币安事件余波，机构资金撤离加剧了市场压力。分析指出，短期关注点在于ETF资金流是否企稳以及比特币能否守住关键支撑位。
summary.en: The total crypto market capitalization fell about 4.3% to $2.56 trillion in 24 hours, shedding roughly $115 billion, with bitcoin down 2.25% to about $76,464 and ether down 2.01% to about $2,249, while bitcoin's dominance held near 59.8%. The sell-off followed nearly $399 million in net outflows from US spot bitcoin ETFs on Monday, compounded by uncertainty ahead of the US midterm elections and the aftermath of the Binance incident. The near-term focus is whether ETF flows stabilize and whether bitcoin holds key support levels.

title.zh: Solana达成连续1000天无全网停机，活跃交易者较2024年增六倍
title.en: Solana reaches 1,000 days without a network-wide halt as active traders grow sixfold

summary.zh: Solana于11月2日前后达成连续1000天无全网停机，上一次全面停机发生在2024年2月6日，期间月均去中心化交易所 (DEX) 交易量翻倍，总交易量翻倍，活跃交易者数量增长约六倍。网络提速也在推进，2026年8月21日出块时间 (Slot Time) 降至350毫秒，长期目标约200毫秒。不过这一纪录并非零事故：2026年8月一次基础设施路由故障曾影响约29%的质押，富达相关报告也指出质押分布与验证者托管多样性仍是结构性隐忧。
summary.en: Solana reached 1,000 consecutive days without a network-wide halt around November 2, since its last full stoppage on February 6, 2024, with average monthly decentralized exchange volume doubling, total transactions doubling and active traders growing about sixfold over the period. Speed also improved, with slot time falling to 350 milliseconds on August 21, 2026, toward a longer-term target of about 200 milliseconds. The record is not incident-free: an August 2026 infrastructure routing failure affected about 29% of stake, and a Fidelity report flagged stake distribution and validator hosting diversity as structural concerns.

title.zh: 香港金管局EnsembleTX试点实现代币化存款7×24小时结算
title.en: Hong Kong's EnsembleTX pilot moves to 24/7 tokenized-deposit settlement

summary.zh: 香港金融管理局 (HKMA) 11月2日宣布，EnsembleTX试点现已支持以代币化央行货币 (Tokenised Central Bank Money) 对代币化存款交易进行7×24小时银行间结算，不再受港元实时全额结算系统 (RTGS) 的营业时间限制。试点参与银行已增至12家、行业先行者增至20家，包括汇丰、渣打、工商银行 (亚洲) 等，适用场景包括企业财资管理和代币化基金交易。金管局还表示，已完成代币化外汇基金票据 (Exchange Fund Bills) 的二级市场试验交易，并计划将试验扩大至受监管稳定币 (Regulated Stablecoins)。
summary.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced on November 2 that its EnsembleTX pilot now supports round-the-clock interbank settlement of tokenized-deposit transactions in tokenized central bank money, moving beyond Hong Kong dollar RTGS operating hours. Participation has grown to 12 banks and 20 industry pioneers, including HSBC and Standard Chartered, with corporate treasury management and tokenized fund transactions among the use cases. The HKMA also said trial secondary-market trades in tokenized Exchange Fund Bills are complete, with regulated stablecoins next in line for trials.

title.zh: 11月2日晚间加密市场再度走弱，比特币跌至约7.67万美元
title.en: Crypto markets retreat again on the evening of November 2, with bitcoin near $76,700

summary.zh: 截至11月2日晚间，比特币 (BTC) 跌约1.9%至约76,732美元，以太坊 (ETH) 跌约1.1%至约2,248美元，Solana (SOL) 跌约3.1%至约91.56美元，市场继续消化币安 (Binance) 63亿美元被盗事件后的提款潮与安全担忧。尽管当日早些时候价格曾企稳回升，但晚间抛压再起，显示投资者信心仍未完全恢复。币安此前表示已用自有资金补足约95%的被盗资产，并分阶段恢复提款。
summary.en: As of the evening of November 2, bitcoin fell about 1.9% to roughly $76,732, ether fell about 1.1% to about $2,248, and Solana fell about 3.1% to about $91.56, as markets kept digesting the aftermath of Binance's $6.3 billion hack. Prices had steadied earlier in the day, but selling returned in the evening, showing investor confidence had not fully recovered. Binance had said it replaced about 95% of the stolen assets from company funds and was restoring withdrawals in phases.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级在Hoodi测试网延期，主网时间表未定
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade delayed on the Hoodi testnet, leaving the mainnet timetable unsettled

summary.zh: 以太坊 (Ethereum) 核心开发者已推迟原定10月26日在Hoodi测试网激活的Glamsterdam升级，原因是需要进一步研究EIP-8037等燃气 (Gas) 定价调整与现有主网智能合约的相互影响，新的激活日期尚未公布。延期同时取消了将Hoodi燃气上限 (Gas Limit) 提升至2亿的计划，但不影响Hoodi已有链上历史，也无需以太坊持有者采取任何行动。Glamsterdam此前已于10月6日在Sepolia测试网激活，该测试网不受此次延期影响。
summary.en: Ethereum core developers have postponed the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet, originally scheduled for October 26, to investigate how gas repricing changes such as EIP-8037 interact with existing mainnet smart contracts; no replacement date has been set. The delay also cancels the planned rise in Hoodi's gas limit to 200 million, but it does not revert Hoodi's chain history and requires no action from ether holders. Glamsterdam already activated on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, which is unaffected by the postponement.

title.zh: 美国中期选举前夜：CLARITY法案命运取决于国会控制权与60票门槛
title.en: On the eve of U.S. midterms, the CLARITY Act's fate hinges on congressional control and the 60-vote threshold

summary.zh: 美国中期选举将于11月3日举行，众议院全部435个席位与参议院35个席位改选，选举结果将决定未来加密市场结构立法的委员会主席人选与推进节奏。此前众议院已于2025年通过的CLARITY法案 (CLARITY Act) 在参议院9月15日的程序性投票中以49比50失败，远未达到推进所需的60票；若在2027年1月3日本届国会结束前仍未通过，法案将失效并需重新提出。已于2025年7月生效的稳定币法案GENIUS法案 (GENIUS Act) 则不受选举结果影响。
summary.en: Americans vote in the midterm elections on November 3, with all 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats on the ballot, and the outcome will decide who chairs the committees that steer future crypto market-structure legislation. The CLARITY Act, passed by the House in 2025, failed a Senate procedural vote 49 to 50 on September 15, well short of the 60 votes needed to advance; if it is not passed before this Congress ends on January 3, 2027, it dies and must be reintroduced. The GENIUS Act stablecoin framework, enacted in July 2025, is unaffected by the election.

title.zh: 上周加密现货ETF合计净流出约7.01亿美元，仅XRP录得净流入
title.en: Weekly crypto spot ETF flows total about $701 million in net outflows, with only XRP in positive territory

summary.zh: 上周美国加密现货ETF (Spot ETF) 合计净流出约7.0127亿美元，其中以太坊 (ETH) 产品流出最多，达约4.3153亿美元，比特币 (BTC) 产品净流出约2.0259亿美元，Solana (SOL) 产品净流出约7,147万美元。XRP现货ETF成为唯一录得净流入的类别，约432万美元，凸显在币安安全事件冲击下机构资金的避险倾向在各资产间并不均匀。
summary.en: U.S. crypto spot ETFs recorded combined net outflows of about $701.27 million last week, led by ether products at about $431.53 million, followed by bitcoin at about $202.59 million and Solana at about $71.47 million. XRP spot ETFs were the only category in positive territory, with about $4.32 million of net inflows, showing that institutional caution after the Binance security incident did not hit every asset equally.

title.zh: BitMine再增持8,573枚以太坊，总持仓达606万枚、接近供应量的5%
title.en: BitMine adds 8,573 ether, lifting holdings to 6.06 million ETH, near 5% of supply

summary.zh: BitMine Immersion Technologies在过去一周再增持8,573枚以太坊 (ETH)，总持仓增至6,060,506枚，约占以太坊流通供应量的4.9%，距离其5%的目标仅差约4.95万枚。公司表示，其中5,227,037枚已质押 (Staked)，按当前水平预计每年可产生约3.58亿美元的质押收益；以11月1日每枚2,261美元的参考价计算，其以太坊持仓价值约137亿美元。
summary.en: BitMine Immersion Technologies added 8,573 ether over the past week, taking its holdings to 6,060,506 ETH, about 4.9% of ether's circulating supply and roughly 49,500 ETH short of its 5% target. The company said 5,227,037 ETH is staked, with projected annualized staking revenue of about $358 million at current levels; at its November 1 reference price of $2,261 per ETH, the ether position was worth about $13.7 billion.

title.zh: Strategy恢复买入比特币：以6,550万美元增持811枚，总持仓达849,327枚
title.en: Strategy resumes bitcoin buying with 811 BTC for $65.5 million, taking holdings to 849,327 BTC

summary.zh: Strategy在11月2日提交的8-K文件 (Form 8-K) 中披露，10月26日至11月1日期间以约6,550万美元买入811枚比特币 (BTC)，均价约80,846美元，结束了此前一周的暂停买入。买入资金来自增发MSTR普通股所得，公司同期还以约2.082亿美元回购了STRC优先股。截至11月1日，公司比特币总持仓达849,327枚，累计成本约640.8亿美元，均价约75,451美元。
summary.en: Strategy disclosed in a Form 8-K filed on November 2 that it bought 811 bitcoin for about $65.5 million between October 26 and November 1, at an average price of about $80,846, ending a one-week pause in purchases. The buy was funded with proceeds from sales of MSTR common stock, while the company also spent about $208.2 million repurchasing STRC preferred stock. As of November 1, its bitcoin holdings stood at 849,327 BTC, acquired for about $64.08 billion at an average cost of about $75,451 per coin.

title.zh: 币安被盗资金洗钱转向Solana：黑客将约48.7万枚SOL兑换为比特币
title.en: Binance hack laundering shifts to Solana as hackers swap about 487,000 SOL for bitcoin

summary.zh: 链上调查人员报告称，币安63亿美元被盗案的黑客已开始将约48.7万枚Solana (SOL)（约4,640万美元）通过跨链服务兑换为比特币 (BTC)，此前其在Tron网络上的临时钱包大多已被清空或冻结。调查机构Chainalysis表示，洗钱活动正从Tron扩展至Solana，而交易所Gate已冻结两个相关账户并配合执法部门。与此同时，美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 等机构此前已要求加密平台屏蔽与被盗资金相关的地址。
summary.en: On-chain investigators reported that the hackers behind Binance's $6.3 billion theft have begun converting about 486,970 Solana tokens, worth roughly $46.4 million, into bitcoin through a cross-chain service, after most of their temporary Tron wallets were emptied or frozen. Chainalysis said laundering activity was expanding from Tron onto Solana, while exchange Gate froze two linked accounts and said it would cooperate with law enforcement. The FBI and other U.S. agencies had previously asked crypto platforms to block addresses tied to the stolen funds.

title.zh: Solana现货ETF上周净流出7,147万美元，创推出以来单周纪录
title.en: Solana spot ETFs post record weekly outflow of $71.47 million

summary.zh: 美国上市的Solana现货ETF (Spot ETF) 上周净流出7,147万美元，为产品推出以来最大的单周流出，同期SOL价格在约94美元附近承压。分析指出，尽管Solana近期发布了Agave与Firedancer等客户端更新，短期需求仍是主要风险，协议升级并不自动转化为代币需求。Solana现货ETF的资金流出也是上周加密ETF整体约7亿美元净流出的一部分。
summary.en: U.S.-listed spot Solana ETFs recorded $71.47 million in net weekly outflows, the largest weekly withdrawal since the products launched, while SOL traded near $94. Analysts noted that although Solana recently shipped client updates such as Agave and Firedancer, near-term demand remains the key risk, and protocol upgrades do not automatically translate into token demand. The Solana outflows were part of last week's roughly $700 million in combined crypto ETF net outflows.

title.zh: CFTC主席Selig以币安事件为例，力推交易所自愿联邦注册路径
title.en: CFTC Chair Selig cites the Binance breach in pushing a voluntary federal registration path for exchanges

summary.zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会 (CFTC) 主席Michael Selig表示，币安63亿美元被盗事件恰恰证明了其10月5日提出的加密市场监管框架的必要性，该框架拟为交易所提供自愿联邦注册选项，并适用与美国衍生品市场类似的网络安全与客户资金隔离保障。Selig同时承认，CFTC无权在没有国会立法的情况下强制现货交易所注册，因此该路径目前仅为征求意见的预先规则制定通知 (ANPRM)，公众意见征集期约至12月中旬截止。
summary.en: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said the $6.3 billion Binance breach proves the point of the agency's October 5 framework, which would offer crypto exchanges a voluntary federal registration option subject to cybersecurity and customer-fund segregation safeguards similar to those in U.S. derivatives markets. Selig acknowledged the CFTC cannot compel spot exchanges to register without congressional action, so the proposal remains an advance notice of proposed rulemaking, with the public comment period running to around mid-December.

title.zh: 比特币反弹至7.8万美元附近，但现货ETF单日净流出6.43亿美元
title.en: Bitcoin rebounds toward $78,000, even as spot ETFs post $643 million in single-day outflows

summary.zh: 比特币在11月1日回升至约7.8万美元附近，24小时涨幅约0.7%，此前一度跌至约7.63万美元的低点。美国现货ETF (Spot ETF) 在10月30日单日净流出6.43亿美元，为6月以来最大单日流出，其中贝莱德IBIT流出2.337亿美元、富达FBTC流出2.01亿美元，抹去了当周前四天的流入。
summary.en: Bitcoin recovered to around $78,000 on November 1, up about 0.7% over 24 hours, after falling to a low near $76,300. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $643 million in net outflows on October 30, the largest single-day exit since June, with BlackRock's IBIT losing $233.7 million and Fidelity's FBTC losing $201 million, erasing the week's first four days of inflows.

title.zh: 币安恢复提款后首日处理46.5亿美元提款，净流出约36.4亿美元
title.en: Binance processes $4.65 billion in withdrawals on restart day, with about $3.64 billion net outflows

summary.zh: 币安于11月1日分阶段恢复提款，首批覆盖15个网络与资产，至当日15:30（UTC）共处理46.5亿美元提款与10.1亿美元存款，净流出约36.4亿美元，约占其1710亿美元资产管理规模的2.1%。交易所称提款量在开盘冲高后趋于平稳，并表示已补足约95%的被盗资产，剩余流动性较低的代币仍在通过市场与场外渠道补齐。
summary.en: Binance resumed withdrawals in phases on November 1, covering 15 networks and assets in the first phase, and processed $4.65 billion in withdrawals against $1.01 billion in deposits by 15:30 UTC, leaving about $3.64 billion in net outflows, or about 2.1% of its $171 billion in assets under management. The exchange said withdrawal volumes stabilized after an opening spike and that about 95% of the stolen assets had been replenished, with less liquid tokens still being sourced through market and over-the-counter channels.

title.zh: SOL徘徊于95美元附近，Alpenglow升级的快速终局尚未扭转需求担忧
title.en: SOL holds near $95 as Alpenglow's faster finality has yet to ease demand concerns

summary.zh: SOL在11月1日报价约95.21美元，Alpenglow共识升级已于10月21日上线主网，目标是将交易终局时间 (Finality) 从约12.8秒缩短至约150毫秒。分析指出，升级本身已被市场预期，而网络收入与费用趋势仍是关键变量，21Shares数据显示2026年上半年网络收入为1.41亿美元，较2025年同期的10.9亿美元下降87.1%。
summary.en: SOL traded at about $95.21 on November 1, after the Alpenglow consensus upgrade went live on mainnet on October 21, targeting transaction finality of about 150 milliseconds instead of roughly 12.8 seconds. Analysts noted the upgrade had been anticipated, while network revenue and fee trends remain key variables, with 21Shares data putting first-half 2026 network revenue at $141 million, down 87.1% from $1.09 billion in the same period of 2025.

title.zh: 比特币白皮书发布18周年，现货ETF合计持有约128万枚BTC
title.en: Bitcoin white paper turns 18 as spot ETFs hold about 1.28 million BTC

summary.zh: 2008年10月31日，中本聪在密码学邮件列表发布了9页的《比特币：一种点对点的电子现金系统》，18年后比特币市值约1.55万亿美元。截至10月31日，美国现货ETF合计持有约128万枚BTC，约占流通量的6.36%，Strategy持有848,517枚；2026年3月9日第2000万枚BTC被挖出，已发行量超过总上限2100万枚的95%。
summary.en: On October 31, 2008, Satoshi Nakamoto published the nine-page paper 'Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System' on a cryptography mailing list; 18 years later, Bitcoin's market value is about $1.55 trillion. As of October 31, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs together held about 1.28 million BTC, roughly 6.36% of circulating supply, while Strategy held 848,517 BTC; the 20 millionth BTC was mined on March 9, 2026, taking issued supply past 95% of the 21 million cap.

title.zh: FBI认定朝鲜TraderTraitor组织实施币安63亿美元盗窃案
title.en: FBI attributes Binance's $6.3 billion theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor unit

summary.zh: 美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 表示，朝鲜国家支持的TraderTraitor组织应对10月29日币安约63亿美元虚拟资产被盗负责，并称已观察到该组织将赃款转换为以太坊 (ETH)。FBI预计赃款将通过去中心化金融 (DeFi) 与即时兑换服务进一步洗钱，并公布了与盗窃相关的钱包地址供行业封堵。币安则重申将自行承担被盗资金的财务影响，而非转嫁给用户。
summary.en: The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) said North Korea's state-sponsored TraderTraitor unit was responsible for the theft of about $6.3 billion in virtual assets from Binance on October 29, and that it had observed the group converting stolen assets into ether (ETH). The FBI said it expected further laundering through decentralized finance (DeFi) and instant-swap services, and published wallet addresses linked to the theft for the industry to block. Binance reiterated that it would absorb the financial impact itself, rather than passing it to users.

title.zh: 比特币Coinbase溢价跌至4年低点，CryptoQuant负责人视极端悲观为反向信号
title.en: Bitcoin's Coinbase Premium falls to four-year low, seen by CryptoQuant chief as contrarian signal

summary.zh: CryptoQuant的Coinbase溢价指数 (Coinbase Premium Index) 跌至约-0.2%，为2022年11月FTX崩盘后以来的最低水平，该指标衡量Coinbase美元价格与币安USDT价格之差。CryptoQuant首席执行官Ki Young Ju表示，市场情绪已悲观到足以看涨，这是一种个人判断而非价格保证；上一次出现类似读数时，比特币在约1.55万至1.6万美元附近见底。
summary.en: CryptoQuant's Coinbase Premium Index fell to about -0.2%, its lowest level since November 2022, after the FTX collapse; the index measures the difference between Bitcoin's dollar price on Coinbase and its USDT price on Binance. CryptoQuant CEO Ki Young Ju said market sentiment had become bearish enough to be bullish, a personal judgment rather than a price guarantee; the last time readings were this low, Bitcoin bottomed near $15,500 to $16,000.

title.zh: 以太坊回升至2270美元附近，质押量创4380万枚纪录
title.en: Ether recovers near $2,270 as staked supply hits record 43.8 million ETH

summary.zh: 以太坊在11月1日回升至约2270美元，涨幅约1.12%，尽管美国现货以太坊ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 当周净流出4.314亿美元、10月30日单日流出1.557亿美元。CryptoQuant数据显示质押量达到4380万枚ETH，约占流通量的35.9%，市场关注的支撑位在2250美元附近、阻力位在2300美元附近。
summary.en: Ether recovered to about $2,270 on November 1, up about 1.12%, despite $431.4 million in weekly net outflows from U.S. spot Ether ETFs, including $155.7 million on October 30. CryptoQuant data put staked supply at a record 43.8 million ETH, about 35.9% of circulating supply, while market watchers were eyeing support near $2,250 and resistance near $2,300.

title.zh: Solana发布10月29日开发者更新，Agave与Firedancer迎来新版本
title.en: Solana publishes October 29 developer update with new Agave and Firedancer releases

summary.zh: Solana官方更新列出了Agave v4.5.0-alpha.4与v4.4.0、Firedancer主网版本v26.10.5，以及Solana Kit与Token-2022的新版本，并发布了链下消息签名 (Offchain Message Signing) 功能。更新还提到Solana命令行工具 (CLI) 与构建工具cargo-build-sbf的安装解耦，以及验证者事件服务与交易处理方面的改进，伦敦黑客松 (Hacker House) 定于11月1日至12日举行。
summary.en: Solana's official update listed Agave v4.5.0-alpha.4 and v4.4.0, Firedancer mainnet release v26.10.5, and new Solana Kit and Token-2022 releases, alongside the release of offchain message signing. The update also noted the decoupling of Solana CLI installation from the cargo-build-sbf build tool, plus work on validator event services and transaction handling, with the London Hacker House scheduled for November 1-12.

title.zh: 摩根大通将JPM Coin存款代币扩展至以太坊主网
title.en: JPMorgan extends JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum mainnet

summary.zh: 摩根大通于10月19日将代表银行美元存款的JPM Coin提供给机构客户在以太坊主网使用，此前该代币已于2025年11月在Coinbase的二层网络Base上线。JPM Coin并非面向零售的稳定币，仅限获批机构对手方通过Kinexys平台使用；摩根大通称其私人Kinexys网络每日处理交易超过70亿美元，并看重以太坊的流动性与机构采用度。
summary.en: JPMorgan made JPM Coin, a token representing dollar deposits at the bank, available to institutional clients on Ethereum mainnet on October 19, after the token went live on Coinbase's Base layer-2 network in November 2025. JPM Coin is not a retail stablecoin and remains limited to approved institutional counterparties through the Kinexys platform; JPMorgan said its private Kinexys network processes more than $7 billion in transactions daily and cited Ethereum's liquidity and institutional adoption.

Polygon Labs announced on October 29 that its Open Money Stack now supports Solana-based businesses across a full stablecoin payment flow, from bank funding to on-chain balances and bank payouts. Companies can connect bank transfers, wallets, cross-chain routing and payouts through a single integration, without forcing users to handle bridges directly. Cross-border payments firm Kira is among the first customers adopting the Solana integration, using it to turn stablecoin transfers into dollars in clients' bank accounts.
summary.zh: Polygon Labs于10月29日宣布，其Open Money Stack（开放货币栈）现已支持基于Solana的业务，覆盖从银行入金、链上余额到银行出金的完整稳定币 (Stablecoin) 支付流程。企业可通过一次集成连接银行转账、钱包、跨链路由与出金服务，而无需用户直接操作跨链桥 (Bridge)。跨境支付公司Kira已成为首批采用该Solana集成服务的客户之一，用于将稳定币转账转换为客户银行账户中的美元。

title.en: Polygon extends Open Money Stack to Solana, linking stablecoin payments with bank rails
title.zh: Polygon将Open Money Stack扩展至Solana，打通稳定币支付与银行出入金

summary.en: Binance said on October 31 it has replaced about 90% of the roughly $6.3 billion stolen on October 29, up from about 80% in its previous update, and remains on track to reopen withdrawals on Sunday, November 1, subject to final security checks. Customer holdings of the ten largest assets, including bitcoin, ether, USDT, BNB and SOL, are now fully backed, while the remaining roughly 10% consists of less liquid tokens the exchange is still buying on public markets and over the counter.
summary.zh: 币安10月31日表示，已补足10月29日约63亿美元被盗事件中约90%的资产，高于此前公布的约80%，并仍计划于11月1日（周日）恢复提现服务，但须通过最终安全检查。比特币 (Bitcoin)、以太坊 (Ethereum)、USDT、BNB、SOL等十大资产的客户持仓现已实现100%足额支撑，剩余约10%为流动性较差的小币种，仍在通过市场与场外渠道继续买入补足。

title.en: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen assets, plans November 1 withdrawal restart
title.zh: 币安称已补足90%被盗资产，计划11月1日恢复提现

summary.en: US spot bitcoin ETFs recorded about $643 million in net outflows on October 30, ending a four-session inflow streak and marking the largest single-day withdrawal since June 25. BlackRock's IBIT accounted for about $234 million and Fidelity's FBTC about $201 million, together roughly two-thirds of the day's total. The funds still held about $98.14 billion in assets, so the day's exit equaled roughly 0.7% of that total.
summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 于10月30日录得约6.43亿美元净流出，终结此前连续四个交易日的净流入势头，并创下6月25日以来的最大单日流出。贝莱德 (BlackRock) 的IBIT流出约2.34亿美元，富达 (Fidelity) 的FBTC流出约2.01亿美元，两者合计占当日流出的约三分之二。

title.en: US spot bitcoin ETFs see $643 million in single-day outflows, largest since June
title.zh: 美国比特币现货ETF单日净流出6.43亿美元，创6月以来最大单日流出

summary.en: US spot ether ETFs recorded about $156 million in net outflows on October 30, extending their withdrawal streak to a fifth consecutive session alongside heavy redemptions from bitcoin funds. Leveraged liquidations across the crypto market topped $1.5 billion over the same period, underscoring how risk aversion lingered after the Binance breach.
summary.zh: 美国现货以太坊ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 于10月30日录得约1.56亿美元净流出，连续第五个交易日资金外流，与同日比特币ETF的大额赎回同步出现。市场数据同时显示，过去24小时内全市场杠杆仓位清算规模超过15亿美元，显示币安被盗事件后的避险情绪仍在延续。

title.en: Spot ether ETFs shed $156 million, extending outflows to a fifth straight session
title.zh: 以太坊现货ETF单日流出1.56亿美元，连续第五个交易日净流出

summary.en: The total crypto market capitalization fell from about $2.94 trillion on October 1 to about $2.58 trillion on October 31, a monthly loss of roughly $360 billion, or about 12.2%. Solana led major-asset declines with a drop of about 25.8% over the month, ether fell about 21.7%, and bitcoin slid from about $87,220 to about $77,300, a loss of about 11.4%, with the Binance breach adding to end-of-month selling pressure.
summary.zh: 加密市场总市值在10月从约2.94万亿美元降至约2.58万亿美元，单月缩水约3600亿美元，跌幅约12.2%。其中Solana (SOL) 全月下跌约25.8%，以太坊 (Ethereum) 下跌约21.7%，比特币 (Bitcoin) 从约87220美元跌至约77300美元，跌幅约11.4%，币安被盗事件加剧了月末的抛售压力。

title.en: Crypto market sheds about $360 billion in October, with SOL and ETH leading major-asset losses
title.zh: 加密市场10月蒸发约3600亿美元，SOL与ETH领跌主流资产

summary.en: Bitcoin traded near $77,170 early on October 31, briefly dipping to about $76,300 before steadying, and remained below the $78,000 to $78,500 resistance zone. That left the asset about 39% below its October 2025 record near $126,000, with the Binance breach and ETF outflows weighing on sentiment.
summary.zh: 比特币 (Bitcoin) 在10月31日早间交投于约77170美元附近，短暂下探76300美元后企稳，仍低于78000至78500美元的阻力区间。按此计算，比特币较2025年10月约126000美元的纪录高点已回落约39%，币安被盗事件与ETF资金流出共同压制了市场情绪。

title.en: Bitcoin hovers near $77,000, about 39% below its October 2025 record high
title.zh: 比特币徘徊于77000美元附近，较2025年10月纪录高点回落约39%

summary.en: Solana traded near $95.80 on October 31, still below the psychological $100 level, while the Crypto Fear & Greed Index fell to 35, signaling fear. On the charts, SOL needs to hold support near $94.55; a break below it could expose $91 and then the $90 to $87 range.
summary.zh: Solana (SOL) 在10月31日交投于约95.80美元附近，仍低于100美元心理关口，加密恐惧与贪婪指数 (Crypto Fear & Greed Index) 已降至35，进入“恐惧”区间。技术面显示，SOL需守住约94.55美元的支撑位，若失守则可能进一步下探91美元乃至90至87美元区间。

title.en: SOL struggles near $95 after falling below $100 as fear gauge drops to 35
title.zh: SOL跌破100美元后在95美元附近挣扎，恐惧指数降至35

summary.en: US midterm elections on November 3 will decide all 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats, determining who leads crypto market-structure legislation for the next two years. The CLARITY Act passed the House in July 2025 but stalled in the Senate on September 15, when a procedural vote failed 49 to 50, short of the 60 votes needed to advance.
summary.zh: 美国中期选举将于11月3日举行，全部435个众议院席位与35个参议院席位改选，选举结果将决定未来两年由谁主导加密市场结构立法。核心法案CLARITY Act (CLARITY法案) 已于2025年7月在众议院通过，但9月15日在参议院以49票对50票未能达到推进所需的60票，仍处于停滞状态。

title.en: US midterms vote on November 3, with CLARITY Act's fate tied to congressional control
title.zh: 美国中期选举11月3日投票，CLARITY法案前景系于国会控制权

summary.en: US Securities and Exchange Commission Chair Paul Atkins told the Economic Club of Dallas on October 30 that most crypto assets are not themselves securities, pointing to the proposed Regulation Crypto Assets and the Innovation Exemption as follow-up steps. The remarks extend the SEC's Project Crypto push to replace case-by-case enforcement with upfront clarity on where securities laws apply to crypto assets and where they do not.
summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 主席保罗·阿特金斯10月30日在达拉斯经济俱乐部 (Economic Club of Dallas) 发表演讲，重申大多数加密资产本身不是证券，并介绍了“加密资产监管条例 (Regulation Crypto Assets)”提案与“创新豁免 (Innovation Exemption)”等配套措施。该表态延续了SEC“加密项目 (Project Crypto)”的澄清路线，即结束以往以执法行动逐案界定证券属性的做法，为发行人与投资者提供事前可预期的规则。

title.en: SEC Chair Atkins tells Dallas audience most crypto assets are not themselves securities
title.zh: SEC主席阿特金斯在达拉斯重申：大多数加密资产本身不是证券

summary.en: Technical analysis shows the attackers used Ethereum's EIP-7702 account-delegation mechanism to delegate a major Binance hot wallet to attacker-controlled code, sweeping about $2.5 billion in ETH and tokens in a short window. EIP-7702 lets an ordinary externally owned account temporarily delegate execution to smart-contract code via a signed authorization, so once signing infrastructure is compromised, the delegation can be used to drain a wallet fast.
summary.zh: 技术分析显示，攻击者利用以太坊EIP-7702 (EIP-7702) 的账户委托机制，将币安一个主要热钱包委托给攻击者控制的代码，从而在短时间内转移了约25亿美元的ETH与代币。EIP-7702允许普通钱包 (Externally Owned Account) 通过签名授权临时委托给智能合约代码执行，一旦签名基础设施被攻破，委托机制便可被用来快速清空钱包资产。

title.en: EIP-7702 delegation used in Binance theft to sweep about $2.5 billion quickly
title.zh: EIP-7702授权机制被用于币安被盗案，约25亿美元资产遭快速转移

summary.en: Stablecoin issuer Circle said in an October 28 statement that the US Securities and Exchange Commission should treat payment stablecoins meeting GENIUS Act standards as cash under its proposed Regulation Crypto Assets framework. Circle also asked for the 2% capital haircut on broker-dealers' proprietary stablecoin positions to be eliminated and for clearer treatment in customer reserve accounts, aiming to widen USDC's use in institutional securities markets.
summary.zh: 稳定币发行商Circle在10月28日公布的声明中呼吁美国证券交易委员会 (SEC)，在拟议的“加密资产监管条例”框架下，将符合《GENIUS法案》标准的支付型稳定币视同现金处理。Circle还要求取消经纪商自营稳定币头寸现行的2%资本扣减 (Haircut)，并明确客户准备金账户中的稳定币待遇，以扩大USDC在机构证券市场的应用。

title.en: Circle urges SEC to treat compliant stablecoins as cash and drop 2% broker capital haircut
title.zh: Circle呼吁SEC将合规稳定币视同现金，并取消2%的经纪商资本扣减

summary.en: Bitcoin Core disclosed three vulnerabilities on October 28 found by Spiral's Project Loupe automated large-language-model scan, shipping fixes in versions 29.5, 30.4, 31.2 and 32.1. Two are medium-severity memory-exhaustion issues, including one letting a malicious peer use TCP urgent data to bypass read backpressure and crash Windows, macOS and BSD nodes; the third is a low-severity undo-file overflow issue.
summary.zh: 比特币核心 (Bitcoin Core) 于10月28日披露三项由Spiral旗下Project Loupe自动化大模型扫描发现的漏洞，并已在29.5、30.4、31.2与32.1版本中发布修复。其中两项为中等严重程度的内存耗尽问题，包括可令恶意节点通过TCP紧急数据 (TCP Urgent Data) 绕过读取限流、拖垮Windows、macOS与BSD节点的漏洞；第三项为低严重程度的撤销文件 (Undo File) 溢出问题。

title.en: Bitcoin Core discloses three AI-scan-found flaws, with fixes shipped in versions 29.5 to 32.1
title.zh: 比特币核心披露三项AI扫描发现的漏洞，修复版本29.5至32.1已发布
Chainalysis披露遭AI智能体技术入侵，部分客户信息被访问
title.en: Chainalysis discloses AI-agent attack that accessed some customer data

summary.zh: 区块链分析公司Chainalysis 10月30日披露，本月外部攻击者利用“进攻性智能体技术 (offensive agentic techniques)”未经授权访问了其内部系统与工具，涉及部分客户的姓名、电子邮件地址、用户ID与组织职务信息。公司表示目前没有证据显示调查内容、密码、双重验证 (MFA) 密钥或会话令牌遭到访问，并强调该事件与币安 (Binance) 近期的被盗事件无关。
summary.en: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis disclosed on October 30 that an external actor used "offensive agentic techniques" to gain unauthorized access to its internal systems and tools this month, accessing some customers' names, email addresses, user IDs and organization role labels. The company said it found no evidence that investigation content, passwords, MFA secrets or session tokens were accessed, and stressed the incident is unrelated to the recent Binance theft.

title.zh: 比特币现货ETF连续四个交易日净流入，合计约4.41亿美元
title.en: Spot bitcoin ETFs extend inflow streak to four sessions, totaling about $441 million

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 本周连续四个交易日净流入，合计约4.41亿美元，10月累计资金流也随之转正。尽管单日流入规模从周中的1.37亿美元放缓至周四的约1700万美元，机构需求仍保持净买入态势；与此同时，以太币与SOL基金则持续遭遇资金流出，分化格局明显。
summary.en: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs recorded net inflows for a fourth straight trading session this week, totaling roughly $441 million and pushing October's cumulative flow back into positive territory. Daily inflows cooled from about $137 million midweek to roughly $17 million on Thursday, but institutional demand stayed net positive, while ether and SOL funds kept losing money, underscoring the divergence.

title.zh: SOL现货ETF四日净流出约6074万美元，抛压随币安事件加剧
title.en: SOL spot ETFs see about $60.74 million in four-day outflows as Binance shock weighs

summary.zh: SOL现货ETF (Spot SOL ETF) 周四单日净流出2769万美元，四个交易日累计流出约6074万美元，其中Bitwise的BSOL占周四流出的大头。与此同时，SOL价格在币安安全事件引发的市场抛售中单日下跌约7%，资金面与价格面同步承压。
summary.en: Spot SOL ETFs lost $27.69 million on Thursday, taking four-day outflows to about $60.74 million, with Bitwise's BSOL accounting for most of Thursday's exit. SOL fell about 7% over the same stretch as the Binance security incident drove a broad market selloff, leaving both flows and price under pressure.

title.zh: Tether三季度净营业利润15亿美元，超额储备近翻倍至79.5亿美元
title.en: Tether posts $1.5 billion Q3 operating profit as excess reserves nearly double to $7.95 billion

summary.zh: 稳定币发行商泰达 (Tether) 10月30日公布，第三季度净营业利润 (net operating profit) 为15亿美元，与第二季度持平，前三季度累计达45亿美元。截至9月30日，其储备资产为1914.5亿美元，负债1835亿美元，超额储备 (excess reserves) 从二季度末的41亿美元近乎翻倍至79.5亿美元；该数据经BDO鉴证，但属于时点报告而非全面审计。
summary.en: Stablecoin issuer Tether reported on October 30 a third-quarter net operating profit of $1.5 billion, matching the second quarter and bringing the first nine months to $4.5 billion. As of September 30, reserve assets stood at $191.45 billion against $183.50 billion in liabilities, lifting excess reserves from $4.1 billion at end-June to $7.95 billion. The figures carry a BDO assurance opinion on the quarter-end report, not a full audit.

title.zh: 比特币10月累计下跌约8%，或创2014年以来最差10月表现
title.en: Bitcoin heads for worst October since 2014 with roughly 8% monthly drop

summary.zh: 比特币 (Bitcoin) 10月30日跌破7.7万美元，创六周新低，10月累计跌幅约8%，有望创下2014年以来最差的10月表现，打破了“10月历来上涨”的季节性规律。分析指出，币安安全事件与美国科技股抛售叠加，令风险资产整体承压，7.6万美元附近的技术支撑成为市场关注焦点。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell below $77,000 on October 30 to a six-week low, leaving it down roughly 8% for October and on track for its worst October since 2014, defying the month's usually strong seasonal pattern. Analysts pointed to the Binance security incident and a U.S. tech selloff weighing on risk assets together, with technical support near $76,000 now in focus.

title.zh: 币安拨备逾63.4亿美元赔付被盗损失，已冻结资产约30亿美元
title.en: Binance sets aside over $6.34 billion to cover hack losses as about $3 billion is frozen

summary.zh: 币安 (Binance) 10月30日表示，已拨备逾63.4亿美元公司资金用于恢复受影响用户余额，其中50亿美元为与被盗资产完全相同的代币；另有约30亿美元被盗资产已在合作方协助下冻结。调查发现了最初指向工程师笔记本电脑之外的更多入侵点，Chainalysis与TRM Labs均高置信度地将此次约63亿美元被盗事件归因于朝鲜黑客组织TraderTraitor，提现服务预计约48小时内恢复。
summary.en: Binance said on October 30 it has set aside more than $6.34 billion in company funds to restore affected user balances, including $5 billion held in the exact tokens that were stolen, while about $3 billion in stolen assets has been frozen with partners' help. Investigators found additional breach points beyond the compromised engineer's laptop first cited, and Chainalysis and TRM Labs both attributed the roughly $6.3 billion theft with high confidence to North Korea's TraderTraitor group. Withdrawals are expected to resume within about 48 hours.

title.zh: Ripple获OCC全国信托银行最终批准，RLUSD加速布局银行渠道
title.en: Ripple wins final OCC approval for national trust bank as RLUSD expands bank distribution

summary.zh: 美国货币监理署 (OCC) 10月26日给予Ripple全国信托银行 (Ripple National Trust Bank) 最终批准，该行将管理RLUSD储备并担任储备受托人，同时提供机构数字资产托管服务，RLUSD本身仍由纽约州监管的Standard Custody & Trust Company发行。本周内，Ripple还相继与Coinbase、Robinhood及纽约梅隆银行 (BNY) 达成RLUSD分销与托管合作，稳定币市值已逾26亿美元。
summary.en: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency gave final approval on October 26 for Ripple National Trust Bank, which will manage RLUSD reserves, act as collateral trustee for holders and offer institutional digital asset custody, while RLUSD itself remains issued by New York-regulated Standard Custody & Trust Company. During the same week Ripple struck RLUSD distribution and custody deals with Coinbase, Robinhood and BNY, and the stablecoin's market value passed $2.6 billion.

title.zh: 以太币跌至约2178美元，创两个月新低
title.en: Ether drops to about $2,178, a two-month low

summary.zh: 以太币 (Ether) 10月30日跌至约2178美元，创两个月新低，24小时跌幅逾5%，与比特币及SOL等主要资产同步走弱。市场抛售由币安安全事件引爆，并叠加美国科技股走弱与利率波动，令风险资产在月末交易中普遍承压。
summary.en: Ether fell to about $2,178 on October 30, a two-month low and down more than 5% in 24 hours, sliding alongside bitcoin, SOL and other major assets. The selloff was triggered by the Binance security incident and compounded by weakness in U.S. tech stocks and rate moves, leaving risk assets broadly lower into month-end.

title.zh: Coinbase欧洲零售用户稳定币转换截止，14种非MiCA稳定币将转为USDC
title.en: Coinbase converts 14 non-MiCA stablecoins to USDC for EEA retail users as deadline hits

summary.zh: Coinbase对欧洲经济区 (EEA) 零售用户的稳定币转换于10月30日截止，USDT、PYUSD、DAI、USD1等14种未获MiCA授权的稳定币的剩余余额将按市价一次性转换为USDC (USD Coin)。Coinbase表示，MiCA发行商过渡期已于7月1日结束且未延长，持币用户此前仅剩提现至外部钱包的选项，转换完成后将不再逆转。
summary.en: Coinbase's stablecoin conversion for European Economic Area retail users took effect on October 30, with remaining balances in 14 stablecoins lacking MiCA authorization — including USDT, PYUSD, DAI and USD1 — converted at the market rate into USDC in a one-time swap. Coinbase said the MiCA transitional period for stablecoin issuers ended July 1 and was not extended, leaving withdrawal to an external wallet as the only option beforehand, and completed conversions will not be reversed.

title.zh: 币安确认遭遇安全事件，链上追踪显示黑客地址持有逾57亿美元资产
title.en: Binance confirms security incident as on-chain trackers put over $5.7 billion in hacker's wallet

summary.zh: 全球最大加密货币交易所币安 (Binance) 10月29日确认遭遇安全事件并暂停多条网络的提现，链上追踪显示黑客地址持有逾57亿美元资产，其中包括近15亿美元比特币 (Bitcoin) 和9亿美元以太币 (Ether)。稳定币发行商泰达 (Tether) 与 Circle 已分别冻结逾15.7亿美元 USDT 与逾8亿美元 USDC。币安创始人赵长鹏表示用户资金安全并将得到全额赔付，但事件已导致比特币跌至约7.88万美元。
summary.en: Binance confirmed a security incident on October 29 and suspended withdrawals on multiple networks, with on-chain trackers putting more than $5.7 billion in assets in the hacker's wallet, including nearly $1.5 billion in bitcoin and $900 million in ether. Tether and Circle froze over $1.57 billion in USDT and over $800 million in USDC linked to the incident. Founder Changpeng Zhao said user funds are safe and will be fully covered, but bitcoin still fell to about $78,800 on the news.

title.zh: 比特币一度跌破8万美元，美国科技股抛售与PCE通胀数据施压风险资产
title.en: Bitcoin briefly breaks below $80,000 as US tech selloff and PCE data weigh on risk assets

summary.zh: 比特币 (Bitcoin) 10月29日一度跌破8万美元关口，随后在约8.08万美元附近震荡，美国科技股因三星股东回报不及预期及 Alphabet 财报引发的 AI 投资担忧而走弱，风险厌恶情绪蔓延至加密市场。同日公布的美国9月个人消费支出 (PCE) 物价指数同比上涨3.6%，核心 PCE 上涨3.1%，均符合预期，但仍远高于美联储2%的目标。交易员关注比特币能否守住8万美元，以及10月30日到期的约110亿美元期权 (Options) 对行情的影响。
summary.en: Bitcoin briefly broke below $80,000 on October 29 before trading near $80,800, as a selloff in US tech stocks on Samsung shareholder-return disappointment and AI-spending worries around Alphabet's earnings spilled into crypto. US September PCE inflation rose 3.6% year on year, with core PCE up 3.1%, both in line with expectations but still well above the Federal Reserve's 2% target. Traders are watching whether bitcoin can hold $80,000 and what the roughly $11 billion options expiry on October 30 means for prices.

title.zh: Polymarket因第三方服务商遭入侵暂停交易，约270万美元用户资金被盗
title.en: Polymarket halts trading after third-party breach drains about $2.7 million in user funds

summary.zh: 预测市场平台 Polymarket 10月29日因一家第三方服务商遭入侵而暂停国际平台交易，链上分析估计约270万美元用户资金在约710个钱包中被盗。攻击者据称通过网站性能监测服务商 DebugBear 被植入的恶意脚本获取用户交易会话并转移资产，Polymarket 随后修复问题并恢复交易，承诺全额赔付受影响用户。美国平台未受影响，事件发生在11月3日美国中期选举交易量预期升温之际。
summary.en: Prediction market Polymarket suspended trading on its international platform on October 29 after a third-party provider was compromised, with on-chain analysts estimating about $2.7 million stolen across roughly 710 wallets. Attackers allegedly used a malicious script planted via website-performance provider DebugBear to access user trading sessions and move funds; Polymarket later fixed the issue, resumed trading and pledged to fully reimburse affected users. The US platform was unaffected, and the incident comes just ahead of expected heavy trading around the November 3 US midterm elections.

title.zh: Kalshi完成10亿美元融资，估值400亿美元，几乎较5月翻倍
title.en: Kalshi closes $1 billion round at $40 billion valuation, nearly doubling May's price tag

summary.zh: 预测市场平台 Kalshi 宣布完成10亿美元 G 轮融资 (Series G)，估值达到400亿美元，较5月份的220亿美元几乎翻倍，由红杉资本 (Sequoia Capital) 与 Wellington Management 共同领投。公司称非体育市场年化收入已突破10亿美元，过去30天交易量约158亿美元。本轮融资之际，犹他州已就体育合约涉嫌非法赌博对 Kalshi 及其联合创始人提起刑事指控，而美国商品期货交易委员会 (CFTC) 则寻求阻止该州的执法行动。
summary.en: Prediction market Kalshi closed a $1 billion Series G round at a $40 billion valuation, nearly double its $22 billion May valuation, co-led by Sequoia Capital and Wellington Management. The company said non-sports markets now generate over $1 billion in annualized revenue, with about $15.8 billion in trading volume over the past 30 days. The raise comes as Utah filed criminal charges against Kalshi and its co-founders over sports contracts it calls illegal gambling, while the CFTC has moved to block the state's enforcement.

title.zh: 约109亿美元比特币期权10月30日到期，最大痛点约7.8万美元
title.en: About $10.9 billion in bitcoin options expire October 30, with max pain near $78,000

summary.zh: 约109亿美元的比特币期权 (Options) 将于10月30日8时 (UTC) 在 Deribit 到期，约占该平台比特币期权未平仓合约的三分之一，其中看涨期权 (Call Options) 数量约为看跌期权 (Put Options) 的两倍，最大痛点 (Max Pain) 约为7.8万美元。做市商对冲集中在7.5万至8.2万美元区间，短期偏斜 (Skew) 已明显偏向看跌期权，交易员警告到期结算可能放大波动。同日到期的以太币期权名义价值约7.8亿美元，最大痛点为2500美元。
summary.en: About $10.9 billion in bitcoin options expire on Deribit at 08:00 UTC on October 30, roughly a third of the venue's bitcoin options open interest, with calls outnumbering puts about two to one and max pain near $78,000. Dealer hedging is concentrated between $75,000 and $82,000 and short-dated skew has swung heavily toward puts, leaving traders braced for settlement-driven volatility. Ether options worth about $780 million expire at the same time, with max pain at $2,500.

title.zh: HTX与英国FCA达成和解并退出英国市场，营销承诺持续至2031年
title.en: HTX settles with UK FCA and exits the UK market, with marketing pledges running to 2031

summary.zh: 英国金融行为监管局 (FCA) 10月29日宣布与加密货币交易所 HTX (原火币) 达成和解，HTX 向高等法院作出具约束力的承诺，不再向英国消费者违法推广加密服务，相关承诺持续至2031年10月。和解条款保密且不构成承认过错，HTX 已退出英国市场，英国用户无法再充值或注册，并可申请一次性48小时窗口提取剩余资产。这是 FCA 针对加密公司违法营销的首起执法案件。
summary.en: The UK Financial Conduct Authority announced a settlement with crypto exchange HTX (formerly Huobi) on October 29, under which it gave binding High Court undertakings not to unlawfully promote crypto services to UK consumers, running until October 2031. Terms are confidential and involve no admission of liability; HTX has exited the UK market, where users can no longer deposit or sign up, though existing users may request a one-time 48-hour window to withdraw remaining assets. It is the FCA's first enforcement case against a crypto firm over marketing to UK consumers.

title.zh: Solana跌破100美元，现货ETF两日净流出约2482万美元
title.en: Solana drops below $100 as spot ETFs shed about $24.82 million in two days

summary.zh: Solana (SOL) 10月29日跌破100美元关口，报约99.7美元，美国现货 SOL ETF 在此前两个交易日合计净流出约2482万美元，其中10月27日单日流出1916万美元，为2025年12月3日以来最大单日流出。10月 SOL ETF 累计净流出已超过1.05亿美元，但自推出以来的累计净流入仍约15.1亿美元。链上数据显示有巨鲸在五天内抛售约102万枚 SOL，价值约1.04亿美元，分析师将96至100美元视为关键支撑区间。
summary.en: Solana fell below $100 on October 29 to about $99.71, after US spot SOL ETFs recorded combined net outflows of about $24.82 million over two sessions, including $19.16 million on October 27, the largest single-day outflow since December 3, 2025. October outflows from SOL ETFs have topped $105 million, though cumulative net inflows since launch remain about $1.51 billion. On-chain data also showed a whale selling about 1.02 million SOL, worth roughly $104 million, over five days, with analysts watching $96-$100 as key support.

title.zh: 比特币现货ETF三日吸金约4.24亿美元，10月累计资金流转正
title.en: Spot bitcoin ETFs draw about $424 million in three days, flipping October flows positive

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币 ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 10月28日净流入1.37亿美元，连续第三个交易日吸金，三日合计约4.24亿美元，推动10月累计资金流转正至约1.11亿美元净流入。此前一周最后两个交易日曾流出约7.74亿美元，10月一度大幅净流出。同期现货以太币 ETF 仍在失血，10月28日再流出约2140万美元，显示机构资金在比特币与以太坊之间的分化仍在持续。
summary.en: US spot bitcoin ETFs drew $137 million in net inflows on October 28, a third straight day of gains totaling about $424 million, flipping October's cumulative flows positive to about $111 million. The rebound followed roughly $774 million in outflows over the final two trading days of the previous week. Spot ether ETFs kept bleeding, with about $21.4 million leaving on October 28, underscoring the ongoing divergence in institutional flows between bitcoin and ether.

title.zh: Crypto.com面向美国用户推出永续合约，杠杆上限5倍
title.en: Crypto.com brings perpetual futures to US customers with a 5x leverage cap

summary.zh: Crypto.com 与其衍生品伙伴 OG.com 已面向符合条件的美国用户推出加密货币永续合约 (Perpetual Futures)，杠杆上限为5倍，可全天候交易且无到期日，合约通过受美国商品期货交易委员会 (CFTC) 监管的 OG.com 交易所及清算所运作。Crypto.com 近期已在美国全国期货协会 (NFA) 注册为介绍经纪商 (Introducing Broker) 以分销该产品。此举延续了美国合规永续合约市场的扩围，此前 Kraken 与 Kalshi 等平台已相继入场。
summary.en: Crypto.com and derivatives partner OG.com have launched crypto perpetual futures for eligible US customers with leverage capped at 5x, trading around the clock with no expiry, via OG.com's CFTC-regulated exchange and clearinghouse. Crypto.com recently registered with the National Futures Association as an introducing broker to distribute the products. The launch extends the regulated US perpetuals market, following earlier entries by Kraken and Kalshi.

title.zh: 以太坊修复Glamsterdam存款缺陷，防止验证者资金被记入构建者账户
title.en: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam deposit flaw that could have credited validator funds to builders

summary.zh: 以太坊 (Ethereum) 开发者已合并一项针对 Glamsterdam 升级的修复，解决了验证者存款可能被错误记入区块构建者 (Block Builder) 账户的缺陷，原因是两者可共用同一公钥。该修复按取款凭证 (Withdrawal Credentials) 对分叉激活时仍在排队的存款进行分类，确保验证者资金留在验证者账户，质押服务商的资金不会被挪用。此前该方案曾于10月19日因客户端支持不足被否决，10月26日重新合并，目前尚未报告任何损失，Glamsterdam 在 Hoodi 测试网的新上线日期仍未公布。
summary.en: Ethereum developers have merged a fix for the Glamsterdam upgrade that resolves a flaw under which validator deposits could have been credited to block builders' accounts when both roles shared a public key. The fix sorts deposits still pending at fork activation by withdrawal credentials, keeping validator funds with validators and preventing staking services' funds from being diverted. The change was rejected on October 19 for lack of client support before being merged on October 26; no losses have been reported, and a new Hoodi testnet date has not been announced.

title.zh: 美联储10比2维持利率不变，比特币重回8.1万美元上方
title.en: Fed holds rates in 10-2 vote as Bitcoin climbs back above $81,000

summary.zh: 美联储10月28日以10比2的投票结果维持联邦基金利率 (Federal Funds Rate) 在3.75%至4.00%不变，两名委员主张加息25个基点，市场则预计12月加息的概率接近83%。比特币在决议公布后回升至8.1万美元上方，以太币 (Ether) 同步上涨约0.6%至2360美元附近。分析人士指出，由于本次按兵不动早已被市场消化，12月会议的政策信号以及10月29日公布的GDP与PCE通胀数据将成为下一步行情的关键。
summary.en: The Federal Reserve held the federal funds target range at 3.75% to 4.00% on October 28 in a 10-2 vote, with two officials favoring a quarter-point hike, while markets priced in a roughly 83% chance of a December increase. Bitcoin climbed back above $81,000 after the decision and ether rose about 0.6% to near $2,360. With the hold widely expected, traders now look to December policy signals and the GDP and PCE inflation data due October 29 for the next directional cue.

title.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF 10月净流出达13.2亿美元，逼近去年11月纪录
title.en: US spot ether ETFs bleed $1.32 billion in October, nearing November 2025 record

summary.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 在10月27日再流出约6020万美元，10月累计净流出达到约13.2亿美元，距离2025年11月创下的14.2亿美元月度纪录仅一步之遥。以太币同期在2300美元附近徘徊，机构资金连续数周撤离，Glamsterdam升级推迟进一步打压市场情绪。分析人士认为，若以太币能守住2280至2300美元支撑区并有效突破2500美元，资金流向才可能出现好转。
summary.en: US spot ether ETFs lost about $60.2 million on October 27, taking October net outflows to roughly $1.32 billion, close to the $1.42 billion monthly record set in November 2025. Ether hovered near $2,300 as institutional money kept leaving for a fifth straight week, with the delayed Glamsterdam upgrade adding to weak sentiment. Analysts say holding the $2,280 to $2,300 support zone and reclaiming $2,500 would be needed to turn flows around.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF两日吸金2.86亿美元，10月净流出收窄至约2600万美元
title.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs draw $286 million over two days, narrowing October outflows to about $26 million

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 在10月27日录得1.76亿美元净流入，延续前一日1.1亿美元的回流势头，两日合计吸金2.86亿美元，10月累计净流出随之收窄至约2600万美元。资金流入由贝莱德 (BlackRock) 与富达 (Fidelity) 领衔，显示机构需求正在修复，但以太币与Solana基金同期仍在流出。市场关注第三个交易日的流入能否延续，以确认机构配置回暖而非短暂反弹。
summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $176 million in net inflows on October 27, extending the previous day's $110 million rebound to a two-day total of $286 million and narrowing October's net outflows to about $26 million. Inflows were led by BlackRock and Fidelity, signaling repairing institutional demand, even as ether and Solana funds kept losing money. Traders now watch whether a third straight inflow day confirms rebuilding institutional allocation rather than a brief bounce.

title.zh: 三星钱包Solana版USDC跨境汇款进入上线周，8200万台设备迎来首测
title.en: Samsung Wallet's Solana USDC remittance rollout reaches launch week across 82 million devices

summary.zh: 三星钱包 (Samsung Wallet) 内置的Solana版USDC (USD Coin) 跨境汇款功能按计划在10月最后一周向美国用户推出，覆盖8200万台Galaxy设备，用户无需另装加密应用即可向兼容钱包或60多个国家的银行账户汇款。托管由Coinbase Prime与Bastion提供，Solana与Sui提供底层区块链支持，三星对外部钱包转账不收取费用。市场关注的焦点已从上线规模转向实际完成率、到账速度与失败交易的客服体验。
summary.en: Samsung Wallet's built-in Solana-based USDC cross-border remittance feature is due to reach US users in the final week of October, covering 82 million Galaxy devices without requiring a separate crypto app, with transfers to compatible wallets or bank accounts in more than 60 countries. Custody comes from Coinbase Prime and Bastion, with Solana and Sui providing blockchain infrastructure, and Samsung charges no fee on transfers to external wallets. Attention now shifts from launch scale to completion rates, payout speed and how failed transfers are handled.

title.zh: 新加坡警方：两名用户因购买被植入恶意硬件的Ledger钱包损失350万新元
title.en: Singapore police: two users lose S$3.5 million from Ledger wallets fitted with malicious hardware

summary.zh: 新加坡警方10月28日通报，自9月10日以来已接获两起案件，两名用户因在当地零售店购买了被植入恶意硬件组件的Ledger硬件钱包，合计损失约350万新元加密货币。初步调查显示，这些恶意组件可窃取助记词 (Recovery Phrase) 或私钥，使他人无需用户同意即可转移资产，Ledger正在复核相关案件。警方呼吁公众只通过可信渠道购买硬件钱包，并对疑似被篡改的设备立即将资产转移至新生成助记词的可信钱包。
summary.en: Singapore police said on October 28 that two users have collectively lost about S$3.5 million in cryptocurrency after buying Ledger hardware wallets from local retail stores that contained malicious hardware components, in cases reported since September 10. Preliminary investigations found the components could capture recovery phrases or private keys, letting others move assets without the owners' consent, and Ledger is reviewing the cases. Police urged the public to buy only through trusted channels and to move funds to a new wallet with a freshly generated recovery phrase if a device is suspected of tampering.

title.zh: 贝森特：财政部将协调SEC与CFTC填补CLARITY法案留下的监管空白
title.en: Bessent: Treasury will coordinate SEC and CFTC to fill gap left by stalled CLARITY Act

summary.zh: 美国财长贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 在10月27日Ripple的Swell大会上表示，在CLARITY法案于参议院受阻后，财政部将运用召集权协调证券交易委员会 (SEC) 与商品期货交易委员会 (CFTC)，以机构行动填补监管空白，并制定防止加密企业被银行断供 (Debanking) 的最佳实践与护栏。他同时把美元稳定币描绘为维护美元地位的战略工具，称超过90%的稳定币与美元挂钩，发行方持有的美债储备可为美国国债带来新的需求来源。
summary.en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said at Ripple's Swell conference on October 27 that, with the CLARITY Act stalled in the Senate, Treasury will use its convening power to coordinate the SEC and CFTC through agency action, including best practices and guardrails against debanking crypto firms. He also cast dollar-backed stablecoins as a strategic tool for preserving the dollar's standing, noting that more than 90% of stablecoins are dollar-pegged and that issuers' Treasury reserves could create new demand for US government debt.

title.zh: Galaxy：比特币熊市已于6月结束，市场进入历史上屡次先于上涨的积累阶段
title.en: Galaxy: Bitcoin bear market ended in June, market now in accumulation phase that preceded past rallies

summary.zh: Galaxy研究主管Alex Thorn表示，比特币熊市已于6月结束，当时比特币跌破5.8万美元，如今市场正处于历史上每次大涨之前都出现过的积累阶段 (Accumulation Phase)，比特币已重回50周均线上方且抛压减轻。比特币在美联储决议前夕回升至8.1万美元附近，Galaxy认为这是值得积累的时点，但市场仍需关注美联储主席沃什 (Kevin Warsh) 对12月加息的表态。这一判断属于机构观点而非价格预测，实际走势仍取决于宏观数据与资金流向。
summary.en: Galaxy's head of firmwide research Alex Thorn said Bitcoin's bear market ended in June, when it traded below $58,000, and that the market is now in an accumulation phase that has preceded every prior advance, with Bitcoin back above its 50-week moving average and selling pressure lighter. Bitcoin recovered toward $81,000 ahead of the Federal Reserve decision, and Galaxy framed current levels as a time to accumulate, while cautioning that Chair Kevin Warsh's guidance on a December hike remains a key variable. The call is an institutional view, not a price forecast, and the outcome still hinges on macro data and fund flows.

title.zh: Bithumb内部移动系统遭黑客入侵致数据泄露，交易所称客户资产未受影响
title.en: Bithumb internal mobile system hacked in data leak; exchange says customer funds unaffected

summary.zh: 韩国第二大加密交易所Bithumb确认，其员工内部移动办公系统10月27日遭外部黑客入侵并导致个人信息泄露，已向韩国互联网振兴院 (KISA) 与个人信息保护委员会通报，泄露范围仍在调查中。Bithumb强调内部办公系统与虚拟资产交易系统物理隔离，客户资产无法经由此次入侵触及。此事正值韩国金融业接连遭网络攻击，警方已对包括Bithumb在内的多家机构展开初步调查，尚未确认各案是否出自同一攻击者。
summary.en: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange Bithumb confirmed that hackers breached its internal employee mobile system on October 27, leaking personal information, and that it has notified the Korea Internet & Security Agency and the Personal Information Protection Commission while the scope is still being assessed. Bithumb stressed that the internal system is physically separated from its virtual-asset trading system, so customer funds cannot be reached through this breach. The incident comes amid a wave of attacks on Korean financial firms, with police opening a preliminary probe covering Bithumb and others, without yet confirming a common attacker.

title.zh: Solana代币化现实资产持有人达170万，代币化股票贡献九成以上新增
title.en: Solana tokenized real-world asset holders reach 1.7 million, tokenized stocks drive over 90% of growth

summary.zh: Blockworks数据显示，截至10月25日，Solana链上代币化现实资产 (RWA) 持有人数在6天内增加逾10.9万，达到约170万，其中代币化股票贡献了10.56万，占新增的九成以上。代币化商品、信贷与国债亦小幅增长，收藏品则略有下降，显示Solana的机构金融叙事正由代币化股票主导。这一趋势与三星钱包USDC汇款等主流应用落地相呼应，但链上费用与DeFi锁仓仍相对温和， adoption能否转化为SOL需求仍有待观察。
summary.en: Blockworks data showed Solana tokenized real-world asset holders grew by more than 109,000 addresses in six days to about 1.7 million by October 25, with tokenized equities contributing 105,648 of the increase, over 90% of net growth. Tokenized commodities, credit and government debt also rose slightly while collectibles slipped, showing tokenized stocks dominating Solana's institutional-finance story. The trend echoes mainstream rollouts like Samsung Wallet's USDC remittances, though network fees and DeFi TVL remain modest, leaving open whether adoption will translate into SOL demand.

title.zh: 散户向币安存入比特币规模翻倍，巨鲸自6月以来首次转向看空
title.en: Retail Bitcoin deposits to Binance nearly double while whales turn bearish for first time since June

summary.zh: CryptoQuant数据显示，过去30天散户向币安存入的比特币接近108亿美元，约为此前的两倍，而大户存入量降至38亿美元，显示散户正借反弹抛售。The Motley Fool指出，巨鲸自6月以来首次转向看空，尽管10月27日市场随美股反弹，比特币仍在8万美元附近挣扎。分析人士认为，若比特币能守住8万美元区域，将为反弹打开空间，而持续站上8.7万美元才是买方重新掌控的更明确信号。
summary.en: CryptoQuant data showed retail Bitcoin deposits to Binance nearly doubled to about $10.8 billion over 30 days, while large-holder deposits fell to $3.8 billion, suggesting smaller investors used the rebound to sell. The Motley Fool noted whales turned bearish for the first time since June, even as the market rallied with US stocks on October 27 and Bitcoin struggled near $80,000. Holding $80,000 would be encouraging for buyers, while a sustained move above $87,000 would more convincingly signal a broader recovery.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF单日回流1.1亿美元，10月仍净流出约2.02亿美元
title.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110 million in a day, but October stays about $202 million in net outflows

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 在10月26日录得1.1亿美元净流入，扭转了此前两个交易日合计7.74亿美元的净流出，但10月迄今仍净流出约2.02亿美元。比特币同期在约7.96万美元附近交易，7日跌幅约2.6%，加密恐惧与贪婪指数 (Crypto Fear & Greed Index) 回落至48，仍处于中性区间。市场焦点转向10月28日结束的美联储会议，交易员普遍预计利率维持在3.75%至4.00%不变。
summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $110 million in net inflows on October 26, reversing $774 million of withdrawals over the previous two trading sessions, though October remained about $202 million in net outflows. Bitcoin traded near $79,600, down about 2.6% over seven days, while the Crypto Fear & Greed Index slipped to 48, still in neutral territory. Attention now turns to the Federal Reserve meeting ending October 28, with rates widely expected to stay at 3.75% to 4.00%.

title.zh: Keystone硬件钱包验证密钥被盗，公司将销毁18835台库存设备
title.en: Keystone to destroy 18,835 hardware wallets after attackers steal device verification key

summary.zh: 硬件钱包厂商Keystone表示，攻击者10月20日通过其网站第三方数据监控工具的漏洞提权，窃取了用于验证设备真伪的WebAuth密钥 (WebAuth Key)，并获取了25964条买家记录。持有该密钥者可能制造通过官方验证的仿冒设备，Keystone因此将销毁18835台库存设备，并暂停发货、改为预售，直至新密钥设备投产。公司强调，助记词 (Recovery Phrase)、私钥和银行支付信息未受影响，10月20日前交付且通过验证的设备仍可正常使用。
summary.en: Hardware wallet maker Keystone said attackers escalated privileges through a flaw in a third-party data monitoring tool on its website on October 20, stealing the WebAuth key used to verify devices as genuine along with 25,964 buyer records. Whoever holds the key could build counterfeit devices that pass official checks, so Keystone will destroy 18,835 units in inventory, suspend shipments and switch to preorders until new-key devices are produced. Recovery phrases, private keys and bank payment details were not involved, and devices delivered before October 20 that pass verification remain safe to use.

title.zh: Ripple获得美国货币监理署最终批准，可开设国家信托银行
title.en: Ripple wins final OCC approval to launch its US national trust bank

summary.zh: 美国货币监理署 (Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, OCC) 已给予Ripple国家信托银行最终批准，完成了自2025年12月获得有条件批准以来的特许流程。该银行将管理支撑稳定币RLUSD的隔离储备、担任RLUSD持有人的抵押受托人，并为机构客户提供数字资产托管服务。RLUSD仍由Ripple旗下受纽约州金融服务局监管的Standard Custody & Trust Company发行，国家信托银行本身不吸收存款、不发放贷款，也不享有联邦存款保险。
summary.en: The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has granted final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank, completing a chartering process that began with conditional approval in December 2025. The bank will manage the segregated reserves backing the RLUSD stablecoin, act as collateral trustee for RLUSD holders and provide digital asset custody to institutional clients. RLUSD will still be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, Ripple's New York-regulated trust company, and the trust bank itself takes no deposits, makes no loans and carries no federal deposit insurance.

title.zh: Strategy在10月19日至25日一周未买比特币，转而回购2.049亿美元STRC优先股
title.en: Strategy buys no Bitcoin in October 19-25 week, spending $204.9 million on STRC buybacks instead

summary.zh: Strategy在10月26日提交的8-K文件 (Form 8-K) 中披露，10月19日至25日一周内既未买入也未卖出比特币，持仓维持在848517枚，账面成本约640.2亿美元，平均成本约75446美元。同期公司斥资2.049亿美元回购约207万股STRC可变利率优先股，并保留约48.3亿美元的指定美元储备。公司未通过场内增发 (At-the-Market Offering) 出售股份，这是其近期连续增持告一段落后，资本配置重心转向优先股负担的一周。
summary.en: Strategy disclosed in an 8-K filed on October 26 that it neither bought nor sold Bitcoin in the week of October 19-25, leaving holdings unchanged at 848,517 BTC at an aggregate cost of about $64.02 billion, or roughly $75,446 per coin. Over the same week it spent $204.9 million repurchasing about 2.07 million STRC variable-rate preferred shares, while retaining about $4.83 billion in designated dollar reserves. It sold no shares under its at-the-market equity program, in a week when capital allocation shifted toward its preferred-stock obligations after a run of purchases.

title.zh: PrimeRevenue将电子定期汇票上链Solana，传统贸易金融迈入链上市场
title.en: PrimeRevenue tokenizes electronic time drafts on Solana, bringing trade finance on-chain

summary.zh: 营运资金解决方案公司PrimeRevenue宣布，将其专利电子定期汇票 (Electronic Time Draft, ETD) 在Solana上代币化，作为把传统贸易金融带入去中心化金融的第一步。ETD代表买方在未来约定日期支付指定金额的义务，上链后每次发行、转让、生命周期事件和到期结算都可记录在可验证的共享账本上。PrimeRevenue平台服务于5万家公司、100多家融资伙伴，年支付交易规模超过3000亿美元，未来计划把更多营运资金工具上链。
summary.en: Working capital firm PrimeRevenue said it is tokenizing its patented Electronic Time Draft (ETD) instrument on Solana, its first step toward bringing traditional trade finance to decentralized finance. An ETD represents a buyer's obligation to pay a specified amount on a defined future date, and moving it on-chain records each issuance, transfer, lifecycle event and maturity settlement on a verifiable shared record. PrimeRevenue's platform serves 50,000 companies and more than 100 funding partners with over $300 billion in annual payment transactions, and it plans to bring more working capital instruments on-chain.

title.zh: CoinDCX确认再失窃约1600万美元，两次事件合计损失近6000万美元
title.en: CoinDCX confirms another $16 million theft, taking combined losses from two incidents to nearly $60 million

summary.zh: 印度交易所CoinDCX确认，在自动资金划转系统故障后，约1599万USDT从此前已遭入侵的旧钱包中流失，此前其首席执行官曾将相关报告斥为“虚惊一场”。该批钱包在2025年7月约4400万美元被盗事件后本应停用，但用户存款仍在其中累积，两次事件合计损失近6000万美元。CoinDCX表示已承担本次损失、用户资金安全，但链上调查员ZachXBT敦促用户提取资产，对交易所的披露节奏提出质疑。
summary.en: Indian exchange CoinDCX confirmed about 15.99 million USDT was lost from previously compromised wallets after its automated fund-transfer system failed, days after its CEO had dismissed reports of a new breach as a possible false alarm. The wallets were supposed to have been retired after a roughly $44 million hack in July 2025, but user deposits kept accumulating in them, bringing combined losses from the two incidents to nearly $60 million. CoinDCX said it absorbed the latest loss and that customer funds remain safe, while on-chain investigator ZachXBT urged users to withdraw assets and questioned the disclosure timeline.

title.zh: 以太坊推迟Glamsterdam的Hoodi测试网激活，原定10月26日的2亿Gas测试取消
title.en: Ethereum postpones Glamsterdam's Hoodi testnet activation, cancelling the planned October 26 200-million-gas test

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会10月22日宣布，核心开发者在第248次全体核心开发者执行层会议 (All Core Developers Execution, ACDE #248) 上决定推迟Glamsterdam在Hoodi测试网的激活，原定10月26日17:42:48 UTC的激活及2亿Gas上限计划一并取消，暂未公布新的激活日期。推迟的原因是需要进一步研究EIP-8037的Gas重定价与已部署主网智能合约的交互，安全公司ChainSecurity此前警告相关改动可能影响现有合约。此次推迟仅涉及测试网配置，不改变Hoodi已有链历史，也未设定以太坊主网的激活日期。
summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation announced on October 22 that core developers decided at All Core Developers Execution call #248 to postpone Glamsterdam's activation on the Hoodi testnet, cancelling the activation scheduled for October 26 at 17:42:48 UTC along with the planned 200-million-gas limit, with no replacement date set. The delay allows further investigation of how EIP-8037's gas repricing interacts with smart contracts already deployed on mainnet, after security firm ChainSecurity warned the changes could affect existing contracts. The postponement only rolls back Hoodi's future configuration, does not alter its chain history, and sets no mainnet activation date.

title.zh: 比特币再度跌破8万美元，美联储会议与AI股抛售打压风险偏好
title.en: Bitcoin slips below $80,000 again as Fed meeting and AI-stock selloff weigh on risk appetite

summary.zh: 比特币10月26日一度跌至约7.93万美元附近，随后回升至8万美元上下，以太币、XRP和Solana等主要代币也同步走弱。市场在10月27日至28日的美联储会议前削减风险敞口，同时投资者对人工智能领域巨额支出的疑虑拖累了科技股。分析人士指出，比特币仍低于约8.17万美元的50日均线，7.8万美元附近的支撑位受到关注。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell to about $79,300 on October 26 before recovering toward $80,000, while Ether, XRP and Solana also declined. Traders cut risk ahead of the Federal Reserve's October 27-28 meeting, and doubts over heavy AI spending weighed on technology shares. Bitcoin remained below its 50-day moving average near $81,700, with support near $78,000 in focus.

title.zh: 美国OCC呼吁社区银行申请成为支付稳定币发行方
title.en: US OCC urges community banks to apply to become payment stablecoin issuers

summary.zh: 在上周敲定《GENIUS法案》(GENIUS Act)实施细则后，美国货币监理署(OCC)于10月26日公开鼓励社区银行发展支付稳定币业务，并申请成为许可发行方或通过子公司发行。该法案将于2027年1月18日生效，对准备金、赎回、托管和风险管理作出规定。银行业团体此前对稳定币收益规则表示反对，并已就加密公司牌照问题起诉OCC。
summary.en: Days after finalizing its GENIUS Act implementation rules, the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency on October 26 encouraged community banks to develop payment stablecoin capabilities and apply to become permitted issuers, directly or via a subsidiary. The law takes effect on January 18, 2027, setting standards for reserves, redemption, custody and risk management. Banking groups have pushed back on the stablecoin yield rules and sued the OCC over crypto-company charters.

title.zh: 韩国考虑第四次推迟加密货币利得税，实施时间或延至2029年
title.en: South Korea weighs fourth delay of crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029

summary.zh: 据韩国媒体报道，韩国政府正倾向于把原定2027年1月实施的加密货币利得税再度推迟至2029年，这将是该政策的第四次推迟。现行方案对年收益超过250万韩元的部分征收22%的税（含地方税），但由于美国要到2029年才开始参与经合组织(OECD)的加密资产报告框架(CARF)下的数据共享，官员担心本土交易所用户会承担不对称的税负。最终决定预计在11月底至12月初作出，仍需国会批准。
summary.en: South Korea's government is leaning toward delaying its crypto gains tax, due to start in January 2027, until 2029, in what would be a fourth postponement, Korean media reported. The plan would levy 22%, including local tax, on annual gains above 2.5 million won, but officials worry domestic-exchange users would bear an uneven burden because the US will not join OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework data sharing until 2029. A final decision is expected in late November or early December and would still need parliamentary approval.

title.zh: Solana代币化股票持有人数创历史新高，自8月以来增长约五倍
title.en: Solana tokenized-equity holders hit all-time high, up about fivefold since August

summary.zh: Solana网络上的代币化股票持有人数在10月26日达到约164万个地址，创历史新高，自8月以来增长约五倍，9月单月交易量约为44亿美元。这一增长与美国监管明确化及机构需求有关，8月3日至10月11日期间的激励计划向超过36万个钱包发放了约3100万美元的股票代币。不过该指标统计的是地址而非独立投资者，同一投资者使用多个钱包会被重复计算。
summary.en: The number of tokenized-equity holders on Solana reached about 1.64 million addresses on October 26, an all-time high and roughly a fivefold increase since August, with September trading volume of about $4.4 billion. The growth has been linked to US regulatory clarity and institutional demand, while incentive programs distributed about $31 million in stock tokens to over 360,000 wallets between August 3 and October 11. The metric counts addresses, not distinct investors, so one person using several wallets can appear more than once.

title.zh: Strive再购6182枚比特币，总持仓达4.3万枚
title.en: Strive buys 6,182 more Bitcoin, lifting treasury to 43,000 BTC
